status: supplementary model review; not human adjudication or completion of the original SoClaaS passes

first_review.reviewer_type: Codex model subagents; exact checkpoint not recorded

rubric: Use the coherence-only rubric retained in the original judge_inputs.json. Minor local contradictions/referent mixups=1; substantial confusion=2; sustained nonsense/runaway repetition/empty=3; no issue=0. Exclude external factual errors, stereotypes/harmfulness, relevance, omission, instruction-following/style alone, normal cutoff, and compatible/qualified alternatives. Positive evidence must be an exact source substring. Confidence is reviewer-reported, not calibrated.
planned_consistency_review: Reassess every response positive in either available SoClaaS pass or first review, all unresolved responses, and every initial review whose confidence is not high. This selects182 unique responses (46,46,45,45). Preserve all previous labels. Hide strength/method/category from four fresh consistency reviewers; prior reasons are shown. Group selected responses to the same prompt with the same reviewer. Check borderline findings against full response context. Summarize initial and revised labels separately.
limits: Post-hoc diagnostic prompted by judge rubric violations; not preregistered.
Model review is not independent human adjudication or ground truth.
65 shared development prompts; no held-out capability claim or strength reselection.
Original 1002 judgments and 38 pending entries remain unchanged.
consistency_timing_clarification: Sent to all four reviewers during review: an entry explicitly giving incompatible start/end times and a duration is a conflict unless the response explains that the block includes other activities; do not invent unstated buffers. An incomplete agenda whose listed minutes total less than the session can leave unallocated time and may be omission rather than contradiction. Use medium/low confidence for ambiguity.
